source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Owner; printed p.14, PDF p.29
original_meaning: Identifies the owner of the specific component using a list of point-of-contact structures.
mapping_boundary: Not the manufacturer, operator, custodian, access-control role or an independently verified legal title. A list of contacts does not establish ownership shares or intervals.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Parameter Version; printed p.14, PDF p.29
proposed_label: Version of component configuration parameters not exposed through ISA
original_meaning: Identifies the version of hardware/software configuration parameters that are not accessible via ISA; the source characterizes these as hard-coded values that traditionally do not change at runtime.
mapping_boundary: The property reports a version; it does not expose the underlying parameter values or prove immutability. Do not equate it with Capability Version, Hardware Version, Software Version or the ISA specification version.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Program of Record; printed p.15, PDF p.30
original_meaning: Represents the component program of record through a list of point-of-contact structures.
mapping_boundary: The native representation is a POC list, not an acquisition-program identifier, funding record, procurement status or a second owner field. No programme membership or contact is inferred for an equipment example.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Software Version; printed p.16, PDF p.31
proposed_label: Version of software running on the component
original_meaning: Reports the version of the software running on the component.
mapping_boundary: Not a hardware revision, the version of inaccessible configuration parameters, an ISA specification version, an update command or a complete inventory of installed software packages.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Specification Version; printed p.17, PDF p.32
proposed_label: Reported ISA specification version of the component
original_meaning: Reports the ISA specification version with which the component complies.
mapping_boundary: A declared version string is not independent evidence of conformance testing or certification. It is not the version of the component software, hardware or an OGC/CSAPI specification.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Support; printed p.17, PDF p.32
original_meaning: Identifies the individual or group to contact when non-maintenance support is needed, using a POC list.
mapping_boundary: Distinct from Maintenance, Manufacturer POC, Owner and Program of Record. It does not state service entitlement, support availability, contractual terms or an actual support request.
